sentences.en: Install properly the fans and radiator in your computer case.
sentences.zh: 正确安装电脑机箱内的风扇和散热器。

sentences.en: The radiators were barely warm; that's why the flat was cold.
sentences.zh: 散热器几乎不热，这就是为什么房间冷的原因。

sentences.en: I must add water to the radiator.
sentences.zh: 我必须向散热器里加水。

senses.zh: (暖气设备的)散热器 - 汽车引擎的冷却器, 散热器
